### Summary
A brief description of your suggestion.

### Detailed Description
A more detailed explanation of the suggestion. Explain why you think this suggestion would be beneficial, and provide any relevant context or examples.

### Potential Benefits
Describe the potential benefits of this suggestion. How will it improve the project, user experience, or workflow?

### Potential Drawbacks
Are there any potential drawbacks or challenges associated with this suggestion? If so, please describe them.

### Related Issues or Discussions
Link to any related issues, pull requests, or discussions that provide additional context.
